assign.outcome:
**Dictation was not actually broken — proven by driving it four ways, no code changed.** I fed a synthesized sentence into Chromium's real microphone stream (the real `getUserMedia` → `AudioWorklet` pipeline, not a mocked network call), pressed the real 🎤, and watched the right words land on screen every time: the plain [`ux/Dictate` demo](/framework/ux/Dictate/words/), the [dev bar's own mic](/framework/dev/DevBar/) under "the mastermind log" (on every page, `Ctrl+\`), and the dictate box on a real task's Asks tab (`ext/AITask/asks.js`). Whisper-server (127.0.0.1:8178, PID 35172) answered every request correctly and was never restarted or stopped. `Dictate.js`'s whisper URL and `Server/plugins/Whisper.js`'s port are the same string — no path mismatch.

The owner's report was true when they made it; a sibling task this morning (`stash-restore`, landed 10:39, before this one started) had already restored `ux/Dictate`, `ext/Ask/reply.js` and `Server/plugins/Whisper.js` to their working state after last night's stash revert. Nothing was left for this task to fix.

What the revert actually did break, and why it isn't this: `public/framework/dev/DevBar/chat.js` — an uncommitted file that briefly made a fuller "chat" tab (session picker, minion transcripts, a second composer) the dev bar's default — is genuinely gone with no git history to recover it, and `tools.js` was deliberately restored without wiring it in so the dev bar wouldn't crash. Already documented today in `dev/DevBar/doc/chat.md` as a known follow-up, independent of dictation.

**Untested:** a real physical microphone and the owner's own browser tab — I drove a private test server only, headless, never the owner's open tabs. **Named, not fixed (out of fence, already tracked elsewhere):** `doc/chat.md` also documents that the mastermind-log section (which holds this same mic) collapses to 0px tall on a dev bar narrower than 34em — `ai/2026-09-19/card-adopt/`.
